image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a wombat sitting in snow. The animal has a stocky, barrel-shaped body covered in coarse, dark brown to black fur with lighter brown accents on the chest and face. It has a broad, blunt head with small eyes, rounded ears, and a large, bare, pigmented nose. Short, powerful forelimbs with visible claws are planted in the snow. The background is white snow with soft shadows.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape is distinctly broad and blunt. Eyes are small relative to the head size, and ears are rounded and positioned correctly on the sides of the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nose is large, bare, and pigmented.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The nose is prominent, lacks fur coverage (bare), and appears dark/pigmented, matching the taxonomy description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Facial features are small relative to broad head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eyes and ears appear proportionally small compared to the massive width of the skull/face area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Fur is coarse and thick, ranging from sandy brown to dark grey or black.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Texture analysis shows wiry, thick fur. Coloration transitions from dark grey/black on the back to sandy brown on the underside/face, consistent with the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body exhibits robust barrel-shaped form resembling a small bear.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The torso is cylindrical and heavy-set, lacking a defined waist, strongly resembling the 'barrel' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is stocky and heavy-set with a substantial, ground-hugging build.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal sits low in the snow, conveying significant weight and a low center of gravity.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short powerful limbs with broad feet equipped with strong digging claws on forefeet.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Forelimbs are visible, appearing short and thick. Dark claws are clearly visible on the front paws digging into the snow.
The rear of the animal is obscured by the angle and the snow; the tail cannot be visually confirmed or denied.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body exhibits low center of gravity with quadrupedal plantigrade stance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The posture is stable and low to the ground. The front paws appear flat-footed (plantigrade) as they press into the snow.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness/haloing where the dark fur meets the bright white snow, typical of AI generation struggling with high-contrast fine details, but not structurally damaging.
The digits/claws on the left paw blend slightly into each other and the snow, lacking the distinct separation seen in the right paw. It looks slightly 'melted' rather than distinct toes.
